plan.title: Order Activity records post-publish participant addition

steps.note: Create a test event on the buyer portal.
Apply the first available template before adding line items.
Add the required event line item.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line item.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Invite the initial participant required for publishing.
Publish the test event so a participant can be added afterward.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Open the published stage's Participants list to add a participant after publish.
Add another available QA vendor after publication, creating the activity being tested.
Confirm the newly added participant appears in the selected participant list.
Open the stage's Order Activity drawer.
Confirm the Order Activity drawer is visible.
